title: Cartographic road overhaul & stability
features: Redesigned roads across Z0–Z9: proportional wide antialiased carriageways, true 3D perspective tapering, zero-blob Day & Night kerb casings, elevated motorway flyovers and scaled cased route overlays.

Smart non-overlapping roads & smooth transitions: main roads expand first while adjacent minor lanes shift outwards to stay distinct, and wide roads glide into minor roads via smooth S-curve width and colour tapers.

Rock-solid road names while driving: street labels lock to fixed world positions on the road with competition hysteresis and re-entry debounce so names glide smoothly with the tarmac instead of flickering or jumping.

Junction tracking & early ignition-off fixes: sub-unit Q4 close-zoom tracking with post-stop settling converges cleanly at stop lines, plus cooperative shutdown prevents freezes on quick ignition-off right after boot.
